title: Wesley W NDE 3483
content: I was a truck driver for 'Road Runner Trucking' in 1991, and in my third year, and a rookie at flatbed driving. I started my run in Hondo Mississippi, with a load of aluminum framing going to a small town in Southern Nebraska. It was what they call a shutdown load. Meaning if you don't get there on time it will shut down the factory. So I ran non-stop to the destination. Trip started out strange, I stopped in west Memphis to shower and change. I was fuelling up with 150 gallons of diesel in the rain. Two islands away, lightning struck the pump and the transformer starting a fire and scaring the shit out me. Then when I was in Springfield, Missouri, I fueled up and left five minutes before a tornado hit the truck stop. I kept on running, to Kansas City, Kansas stopped for coffee. By this time, I was exhausted but I keep running. I reached Beloit, Kansas (a bump in the road) at 8:00 am and keep running, even though I was having a hard time keeping a wake. I remember reaching over and turning over a tape of Dwight Yokem. That's when it happened. I fell asleep with my eyes open. I must have driven five miles like that. I missed the road construction signs and wrecked the truck. I will leave those details out for they are not important. The next thing I know I was somewhere else (but still the same place). This place existed outside of time and our reality. Yet I was still in the truck. I heard someone speak to me. He/they told me not to be afraid. I was not frightened. I felt whole for the first time that I was allowed to remember. He/they showed me the next crossing, but I really should stay 'here' and not to go on any farther. They/he asked me if I remembered the strange epileptic-like fevers that I had when I was a child. I did. They showed me that they were there then and when I had the bike wreck when I was only five years old. They showed me again. There they/he were. They showed me that He/they were at the birth of my first son. They showed me some other stuff but I was not allowed to remember. Then He/they told me that I was not done yet. He/they brought my attention to the body on the floor of the truck. I remember asking them who he was? All they would say is that I'd better wake him up or he will die in the fire! So I went to shake his arm to wake him when I realized that it was me on the floor of the burning truck! He/they told me that the only way out was through the fire and that it would be okay. Then I was back in my own body coughing and choking on the black smoke. The rest is history. I did receive third and fourth degree burns over thirty percent of my upper body, but that's okay now.

arrival.other_being_detail: He/they spoke to him, told him not to be afraid, showed him events from his life, and directed him to return to his body to escape the fire.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Truck wreck after falling asleep while driving; truck was burning and he later escaped through fire.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He/they showed him past events from childhood and the birth of his first son; he was told to wake his body to escape the fire.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: He found himself 'somewhere else (but still the same place)' while still in the truck, communicated with 'He/they,' then was directed back to his body in the burning truck.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience described as being 'somewhere else (but still the same place)' and 'still in the truck,' with attention later drawn to his body on the truck floor.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “This place existed outside of time and our reality.”; “I fell asleep with my eyes open.”; “All they would say is that I'd better wake him up or he will die in the fire!”; “the only way out was through the fire and that it would be okay.”
